# docker_registry_manifest_list (Resource)

Pushes a multi-platform image index (OCI image index or Docker manifest list) under a tag, assembled from images that are already in the same registry, like `docker manifest create` + `annotate` + `push` or `docker buildx imagetools create`. Everything goes through the registry v2 HTTP API with the provider's `registry_auth`; nothing is pulled and the daemon is not involved. Images from other repositories of the registry are copied in by cross-repository blob mount. The index is a Docker manifest list when every entry is a Docker schema 2 manifest and no annotations are set, otherwise an OCI image index. A change to the entries pushes a new index under the same tag (in place); destroy deletes the index unless `keep_remotely = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Two single-platform images already pushed to the registry ...
resource "docker_registry_image" "amd64" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0-amd64"
}

resource "docker_registry_image" "arm64" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0-arm64"
}

# ... combined into one multi-platform tag (docker manifest create + push).
resource "docker_registry_manifest_list" "app" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0"

  manifests = [
    { image = docker_registry_image.amd64.image_digest_ref },
    {
      image   = docker_registry_image.arm64.image_digest_ref
      variant = "v8" # docker manifest annotate --variant v8
    },
  ]

  annotations = {
    "org.opencontainers.image.source" = "https://github.com/team/app"
  }
}

output "app_index" {
  value = docker_registry_manifest_list.app.image_digest_ref
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifests` (Attributes List) Entries of the index, in order. Each `image` is a reference in the same registry as `name`. An image manifest becomes one entry, its platform read from its image config; the platform attributes override what the config says (`docker manifest annotate`). An index or manifest list contributes all its entries, attestation manifests included, and takes no platform overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifests))
- `name` (String) Reference the index is pushed under, with registry and tag, e.g. `registry.example.com/team/app:1.2` (no tag means `latest`; a digest is not allowed). Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on the index itself, e.g. `org.opencontainers.image.source` (forces an OCI image index).
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification of the registry. Default `false`.
- `keep_remotely` (Boolean) When false (default), destroy deletes the index from the registry (`DELETE /v2/<repo>/manifests/<digest>`, which removes the tag; the registry must allow deletes). When true the index is left in place.

### Read-Only

- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of manifest_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the pushed index.
- `id` (String) The tag reference, the same as `name`.
- `image_digest_ref` (String) `<registry>/<repository>@<digest>` of the pushed index.
- `image_ref` (String) The tag the index was pushed under, normalized to `<registry>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `manifest` (Attributes) The pushed index field by field; `manifests[*].platform` carries the annotated os/architecture/variant/os.features. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifest))
- `manifest_digests` (Map of String) Platform (`os/arch[/variant]`) to the digest of its entry.
- `manifest_json` (String) The index / manifest list as pushed to the registry.
- `media_type` (String) Media type of the index: `application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json` or `application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json`.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms of the entries as `os/arch[/variant]`, attestation manifests excluded.

<a id="nestedatt--manifests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manifests`

Required:

- `image` (String) Source reference, e.g. `registry.example.com/team/app:1.2-arm64` or `...@sha256:...`. Pin a digest to make the index reproducible.

Optional:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on this entry's descriptor (OCI index only).
- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture to record, e.g. `arm64` (`--arch`).
- `os` (String) Operating system to record for this entry, e.g. `linux` (`docker manifest annotate --os`).
- `os_features` (List of String) OS features to record (`--os-features`).
- `os_version` (String) OS version to record, e.g. a Windows build number (`--os-version`).
- `variant` (String) CPU variant to record, e.g. `v8` (`--variant`).

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Upstream `annotations`.
- `manifests` (Attributes List) Upstream `manifests`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifest--manifests))
- `media_type` (String) Upstream `mediaType`.
- `schema_version` (Number) Upstream `schemaVersion`.

<a id="nestedatt--manifest--manifests"></a>

- `artifact_type` (String) Upstream `artifactType`.
- `digest` (String) Upstream `digest`.
- `media_type` (String) Upstream `mediaType`.
- `platform` (Attributes) Upstream `platform`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifest--manifests--platform))
- `size` (Number) Upstream `size`.
- `urls` (List of String) Upstream `urls`.

Read-Only:

- `os_version` (String) Upstream `os.version`.
- `variant` (String) Upstream `variant`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the tag the index is pushed under. The entries are read back as
# digest references (<registry>/<repository>@sha256:...), without overrides.
terraform import docker_registry_manifest_list.app registry.example.com/team/app:1.0
```
